# Homes and Gardens

> > Homes and Gardens is a comprehensive resource for home design, interior decoration, kitchen and bathroom planning, garden inspiration, and home shopping guidance.

Homes and Gardens provides expert advice, design trends, and practical guides across home interiors, kitchens, bathrooms, gardens, and home décor. The site features house tours, celebrity home inspiration, designer profiles, and seasonal gardening tips to help readers create beautiful, functional living spaces.

## Key Topics

- Home Design
- Interior Design
- Kitchen Design
- Garden Design
- Color Trends
- House Tours
- Home Décor
- Plant Care
- Kitchen Storage
- Bathroom Design
- Outdoor Living
- Furniture Shopping
- Home Inspiration
- Designer Profiles
- Interior Decoration

## Core Home Design

- [Design | Decorating | Kitchens | Bathrooms | Gardens](https://www.homesandgardens.com): Homes & Gardens homepage: home design, decor, kitchens, bathrooms, gardens.
- [House Design House Tours](https://www.homesandgardens.com/house-design): House design tours and interior inspiration from homes worldwide.
- [Interior Design: Expert Advice, Ideas and the Latest Trends](https://www.homesandgardens.com/interior-design): Interior design expert advice, color trends, and room layout guidance.
- [About Homes & Gardens](https://www.homesandgardens.com/about-us): About Homes & Gardens: company mission, awards, editorial standards.

## Kitchens and Bathrooms

- [Plan, Design and Decorate Your Dream Kitchen in 2026](https://www.homesandgardens.com/kitchens): Kitchen design trends, remodeling ideas, and expert planning advice.
- [Storage Solutions For Kitchens Without Built-In Food Storage](https://www.homesandgardens.com/kitchens/storage-ideas-for-kitchens-without-a-pantry): Kitchen storage solutions and organization ideas for pantry-less kitchens.

## Gardens and Outdoor Living

- [Get the latest garden design ideas and trends for 2026](https://www.homesandgardens.com/gardens): Garden design ideas, seasonal tips, and plant care guidance.
- [Bee Balm is the Best Plant to Make Your Balcony Smell Nice](https://www.homesandgardens.com/gardens/the-one-plant-you-need-to-make-your-balcony-smell-nice): Bee balm growing guide for fragrant balcony and container gardens.
- [What to Do With a Spider Plant in March](https://www.homesandgardens.com/gardens/what-to-do-with-a-spider-plant-in-march): Spider plant care guide for March maintenance and growth season.
- [5 Essential Plants Every Small Garden Needs](https://www.homesandgardens.com/gardens/the-5-plant-rule-for-small-space-yards): Small garden plant guide: essential plants for year-round interest.

## Design Inspiration and Guides

- [Inside a London Family Home Filled With Sunny Color and Pattern](https://www.homesandgardens.com/house-design/studio-raymond-colorful-london-townhouse): London townhouse renovation tour with colorful design and family layout.
- [How to Design a Romantic Bedroom Around One Hero Pattern](https://www.homesandgardens.com/interior-design/nicole-fisher-pattern-drenched-bedroom): Bedroom design guide: using hero patterns, symmetry, and lighting.
- [See inside celebrity homes - the best celeb home decor and interiors](https://www.homesandgardens.com/celebrity-style): Celebrity home tours and interior design inspiration from famous homes.

## Shopping and Products

- [Shopping](https://www.homesandgardens.com/shopping): Home shopping guide: furniture, appliances, decor reviews and recommendations.

## Practical Home Living

- [Solved: The Hardworking Homes](https://www.homesandgardens.com/solved): Practical guides for functional home living: sleep, cleaning, fragrances.
